system.description:
Size Medium • Speed 30ft • Darkvision 60ft • +2 Str / +1 Con, −1 Cha

Traits

  • Relentless Endurance: 1/day, when damage of any kind would drop you to 0 HP or below, drop to 1 HP instead.
  • Choose one additional skill at creation; you have Advantage on checks with it. This is not a Proficiency tier and does not take an NWP slot.
  • Brutal Strikes: on a critical hit, add one extra damage die of the weapon's type (passive, always on).
  • Onslaught: 1/long rest, spend 1 Luck to make one additional weapon attack, as part of the same action, against a creature you've just damaged (always costs 1 Luck; there is no free use).
  • Weapon training: two-handed axe, battleaxe, javelin, handaxe.
  • Armour training: light, medium.
